# gui_forms::Window

Window is GUI.Forms' portable retained-root coordinator. It owns exact tree identity, update/layout/paint transactions, damage and presentation receipts, live layers, frame requests, UI-thread dispatch, resources, focus/validation/dialog keys, pointer/drag/deferred input, popups and accelerators, metrics, and semantic projection; native adapters reach it only through the host session and wake seams.

- Header: `<gui_forms/window/window.hpp>`
- Kind: class · public
- Contract: **reviewed** (source `docs/reference/contracts/window.json`)

## Syntax

```cpp
class Window
```

## Remarks

Provides resize and logical scale; nested update scopes, explicit layout, flush, paint, and per-plane damage; retained lookup by stable ID and recursive hit testing; focus, pointer capture, pressed state, and routed input dispatch.

Owns the retained accept/cancel targets and the exact retained `DialogResult`; dialog keys route to live targets only after the focused route declines them and never move focus.

A paint pass holds one exclusive UI-thread lease. `paint` returns an exact `PaintReceipt` only after complete backend replay; native hosts present only a valid receipt and then call `notify_presented`. Duplicate, backward, forged-future, and replaced-epoch receipts are rejected and counted.

Exposes frame scheduling, active surfaces, occlusion and wake deadlines, UI timer callbacks, validated PNG resource loading, renderer-free semantic snapshots, and structured metrics.

## Ownership and lifetime

Owns one retained root control tree and one UI thread. The application constructs the Window and keeps it alive for the lifetime of its tree; a native host adapter attaches to it. Window shutdown synchronously revokes timers, popups, paint leases, and pending dispatcher work.

## Thread safety

The Window defines the UI thread. `check_access` reports whether the caller is on it and `verify_access` rejects any other caller; `begin_invoke`/`invoke` marshal work onto it. Only the dispatcher entry points may be called from other threads.

## Availability

Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
